atoms.text: Ocelots are smaller wild cats that live in rainforests in South America and sometimes travel as far north as Texas. They live in rainforests and grasslands, and are usually 8 to 16 kg. They are larger than a house cat but smaller than a wolf. Ocelots have two black stripes on their face and dark spots all over their body. Each animal has its own unique markings, like every human’s thumbprint is unique.

Which body part helps ocelots clean bones?

atoms.text: Ocelots are carnivores and eat rodents, reptiles, birds, fish and other small animals. They have extremely sharp teeth which they use to tear meat off of the bone. They aren't able to chew with these teeth, so they swallow pieces of meat whole. Ocelots also have rough tongues which help them clean off bones.

What does nocturnal mean?

hint.text: Nutze die Scanning-Methode, um den Text effektiv nach der Antwort auf die Frage zu durchsuchen.

atoms.text: Ocelots are much more active at night and prefer to stay hidden during the day, which means that they are nocturnal. Their eyes have an extra layer which helps them see better in the dark. Ocelots spend most of their life alone and are very territorial. They only interact with other ocelots during mating season. Ocelots usually give birth to 2-3 kittens per litter.
